lastCompletedStory.title: Add push-recovered to the push event taxonomy and re-scope push-undelivered to terminal-only

nextStoryContext: US-001 adds types and documentation only; no push-recovered emitter is wired yet. Later wiring stories should emit nothing on first-try delivery, push-recovered only after at least one bare-submit remediation, and push-undelivered only after terminal verification failure. Backend-sensitive supervisor tests now pin an explicit Claude fixture, and Ink frame assertions normalize ANSI output so the tmux behavioral gate remains deterministic.

officialDocsValidated.summary: The current render API still returns lastFrame, stdin, rerender, and unmount; the test-local wrapper preserves that API while normalizing lastFrame text.
